# DevShelf
> The Zero-Paywall Open-Source Developer Directory & Model Context Protocol (MCP) Catalog

DevShelf is a community-driven, open-source directory indexing 565+ verified developer tools, free APIs, AI coding agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with zero paywalls.

Canonical Homepage: https://ritualdev.in/devshelf/
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/DevShelf
License: MIT

## Public REST & Feed APIs
- Tools JSON: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/tools.json
- Categories JSON: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/categories.json
- RSS 2.0 Feed: https://ritualdev.in/feed.xml
- Atom Feed: https://ritualdev.in/atom.xml
- OpenAPI Specification: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/openapi.json
- Embed Badge: https://ritualdev.in/badge/verified.svg

## Quick Start CLI
```bash
# 1. Search the catalog directly from your shell
npx devshelf search "postgres"

# 2. Get full tool explanation, install snippets, alternatives & Docker compose
npx devshelf explain ollama

# 3. List verified tools by category
npx devshelf list --category ai

# 4. Run as local MCP server for Claude Desktop / Cursor
npx devshelf mcp
```

## Programmatic Node.js / TypeScript Usage
```typescript
import { searchDevShelf, getToolDetails } from "@ritualdev-lab/devshelf";

// Query tools matching keyword or category
const results = await searchDevShelf("database", { limit: 5 });
console.log(results.map(t => `${t.name} (${t.license}) - ${t.description}`));

// Inspect single tool specs & alternatives
const tool = await getToolDetails("hoppscotch");
console.log("Alternative to:", tool.alternativeTo); // "Postman"
console.log("Docker Compose:", tool.dockerCompose);
```

## MCP Server Configuration
Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` or `.cursor/mcp.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "devshelf": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@ritualdev-lab/devshelf", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```
Exposes tools: `search_devshelf(query, category)`, `explain_tool(slug)`, `get_alternatives(proprietary_tool)`, and `get_docker_compose(slug)`.
